name: Transmission electron microscopy
summary: A microscope that images thin specimens with electrons and magnetic lenses instead of light, revealing far finer detail; Siemens soon built them for industry.
description: Electron microscopy using a transmitted electron beam and electron lenses to image sufficiently thin specimens.
tier_reason: The scoped record is a particular configuration, local witness, trial or material application. Dependence across fields or generations on THIS referent is not established; do not inherit the importance of its broader missing family.

impact.note: Let researchers see far below the limit of light; used across biology and materials science, and electron microscopy grew from it as a field.

market.note: The documented market event is separate from first availability.
